title: Nullclines of a Competing Species System
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the x-nullclines and y-nullclines for dx/dt = x(3 - x - y) and dy/dt = y(2 - x - y).
finalAnswer: \text{x-nullclines: } x = 0, \; x + y = 3; \quad \text{y-nullclines: } y = 0, \; x + y = 2

steps.title: Find x-Nullclines (dx/dt = 0)
steps.mathExpression: x(3 - x - y) = 0 \implies x = 0 \quad \text{or} \quad x + y = 3
steps.explanation: Vertical velocity is purely vertical along these curves.

steps.title: Find y-Nullclines (dy/dt = 0)
steps.mathExpression: y(2 - x - y) = 0 \implies y = 0 \quad \text{or} \quad x + y = 2
steps.explanation: Velocity is purely horizontal along these curves.
